nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Three blocks around a courtyard. Someone has washing out between the buildings. There is hardly any wind, and the clothes barely move.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: There is a slide and a bench in the yard, with a small patch of grass beside them. Not much grass has taken; most of the ground is concrete.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You reached the flats behind the school: three blocks around a courtyard.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A path runs between the blocks. You have not walked along it, but it seems to begin in a gap between the buildings.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A flight of stairs between two blocks. Eleven steps, a landing, then another flight.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You go up. At the landing, you look back. The stairs below seem to be the ones you just climbed.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You climbed the stair between the blocks and arrived back where you started.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You go back down. There are the same number of steps.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You do not go up. The stairs are still there, leading somewhere above.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Something green is beside the planter. Not the green of the hedge.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You saw a green animal on the concrete beside the planter. You cannot say what it is.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: It is wet, and it moves slowly, the way something moves when it is counting.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: It does not run. It turns its head, keeping its eyes on you.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Up close, you can make it out: a flat bill, wet fur, and a paddle-shaped tail held off the ground.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: The green animal has a flat bill and a flat tail. Nothing else about it is clear.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You stay still. It takes no notice and carries on with whatever it was doing.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: It keeps looking at you. It does not move away or do anything else.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You have seen something like it in the biology book. You want to find the picture, but cannot remember the page.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: Something about the animal is like a drawing in the biology textbook. You cannot find the page.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You still cannot name it. You have no idea why it is here, either.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: It is still there. It has moved about a metre along the planter, towards the alley.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You still cannot tell what it is.
